title: Stability for coupled second order evolution equations with indirect general memory-dampings without the equal-wave-speeds-type hypothesis
summary: We study the stability for a system of coupled second order evolution equations with indirect general memory-damping without the equal-wave-speeds-type hypothesis in a Hilbert space, where the damping only appears just in one equation, the memory kernel can not necessarily be nonnegative and nonincreasing, and the ``wave speeds" implied by the system can be different.
